senses.definition: a poor densely populated city district occupied by a minority ethnic group linked together by economic hardship and social restrictions
any segregated mode of living or working that results from bias or stereotyping
examples: the relative security of the gay ghetto
no escape from the ghetto of the typing pool

senses.definition: formerly the restricted quarter of many European cities in which Jews were required to live
a mental representation of some haunting experience
examples: he looked like he had seen a ghost
it aroused specters from his past
there was a touch of sarcasm in his tone
he detected a ghost of a smile on her face

senses.definition: a writer who gives the credit of authorship to someone else
the visible disembodied soul of a dead person

examples: The masked men ghosted across the moonlit yard
How many books have you ghostwritten so far?

senses.definition: resembling or characteristic of a phantom
examples: a ghostly face at the window
a phantasmal presence in the room
